capabilities: Search and insert adversaries and environments from the SRD
Render editable stat blocks as daggerheart code blocks
Roll dice for attacks and damage with one click
Track marked HP, stress, countdowns, and feature uses
Build encounters in notes or canvas and manage a homebrew library
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation via BRAT is documented. Includes Daggerheart SRD content under the Darrington Press Community Gaming License.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way for Daggerheart game masters to insert, render, and track adversary and environment stat blocks during play.

relations.evidence: Plugin inspired by FreshCutGrass and DaggerForge.
Plugin inspired by FreshCutGrass and DaggerForge.
it is possible to enable compatibility with Fantasy Statblocks in settings

summary: Daggerheart TTRPG stat-block library that searches, renders, and edits adversary and environment stat blocks with dice rolling and session tracking.
